features.label: No additional span restriction explicitly imposed
No additional zero-respecting restriction explicitly imposed

domains.definition: The explicit domain of each operation’s query_signature.

Return $\widehat x\in\mathbb R^{d_x}$. Any measurable postprocessing of the history is permitted, including an unqueried point, an average, or a convex combination, subject only to the stated output domain and feasibility conditions. No extra function value or computable certificate is required.
Assume $f:\mathbb R^{d_x}\times\mathbb R^{d_y}\to\mathbb R$. Both blocks are unconstrained and use Euclidean norms. The joint gradient satisfies $\|\nabla f(z)-\nabla f(w)\|_2\le \beta\|z-w\|_2$.

norms.definition: The Euclidean norm and inner product are $\|v\|_2=(\sum_jv_j^2)^{1/2}$ and $\langle u,v\rangle=\sum_j u_jv_j$. On the joint space use $\|(x,y)\|_2=(\|x\|_2^2+\|y\|_2^2)^{1/2}$. Matrix norms are the induced spectral norms.

objects.definition: Unknown real-valued payoff function $f:\mathbb R^{d_x}\times\mathbb R^{d_y}\to\mathbb R$.
The feasible set is explicitly public. Exact projections and linear algebra use known geometry and reveal no hidden-function information.
